change: Reuse successful discovery and physical pair prefixes through one fixed Float map over a qualified grouped DIV ratio.
admission: Existing unique Float one-to-one frontier, no fills, unchanged valid clock domain, one fixed Float map and qualified grouped rate operands. Dynamic parameters, arbitrary nested maps and other binary operators retain their existing paths.
proof: Discovery-clock coverage and a common successful physical-row prefix are separate from full Pair Done. A constant-size forward sweep promotes the prefix only after all covered clocks succeed. The requested pair is at most one row beyond that prefix and is read freshly.
fallback: Absent or invalid selected discovery restarts ordinary evaluation, including the still-required suffix. No raw samples, values or cross-clock presence are retained. Existing full-completion intervals are unchanged.

source_attribution.change: Only two assert_eq!(condition,true,message) become assert!(condition,message), inside cfg(test). Runtime code byte-for-byte unchanged.
source_attribution.attribution: Performance and query-fixture cohorts retain actual v2 source/binary identities. Final unit, lint and default C builds use v3.

historical_input_binding.attribution: Retained original/input panel from stage159; baseline outputs are accepted stage160 captures, not stage159 baseline executions.

qualification.sparse_failure_scope: Actual Step absence/suffix cancellation plus separate actual dense provider read failures. This is not a sparse-provider suffix-fault panel.
qualification.common_prefix_scope: Whole-query discovery coverage checks are distinct from the direct Step common-prefix advancement and next-target fresh-read checks.
